name: content-gap-alerts
description: Check for content gaps, zero-citation articles, repeated failures, and competitor MCP servers
scheduleReadable: Every day at 9:00 AM (after daily report)

preExec.description: Run all alert checks. Runs dist (not tsx) and omits --discord: the Discord LaunchAgent was retired 2026-07-26; MAESTER parses this JSON and delivers a batched Telegram message.

instructions: Review the JSON output from the alert engine.
Critical alerts require immediate attention (content gaps losing traffic).
Warning alerts should be addressed within the week.
Info alerts (competitor servers) are for awareness.
If zero alerts fired, the system is healthy — no action needed.
